description: Design and scaffold Godot mini-games with headless workflows, web export preparation, and procedural sound effects.

codex.shortDescription: Build Godot mini-games with templates and headless tools.
defaultPrompts: Scaffold a Godot mini-game from the bundled template.
Prepare this Godot game for a headless web export.
Add procedural sound effects to this Godot game.

requirements: Godot 4.2+ and a shell with timeout are needed for headless commands.
Web export needs matching Godot export templates; templates must be installed separately.
